name: app-therapist-appointment-app-with-olive-and-terracotta-and-flat-illustration
title: Four warm-neutral screens: therapist schedule, empty-state illustration, video call and chat, with olive and brown accents
whatItIs: Four black-bezel phones on greige: an appointment timeline with a week strip, doctor cards with ratings, reschedule and cancel links and a brown plus button; an empty state with a flat illustration of a therapist and patient and 'You don't have any appointment for today.' with a brown button; a video call with a full-screen portrait, a self-view tile and a large olive call button; and a chat with brown and white bubbles.
whatItMeans: Calm and humane; warm neutrals with olive feel safe for mental-health care.
techniques: Use olive and brown instead of clinical blue.
Add a flat illustration to an empty state.
Use a big circular action button in calls.

vocabulary.definition: A drawing shown when a list has no items.
A row of day pills at the top.
A small video of yourself during a call.
